svg.text: Custom range picker — one GtkCalendar + AdwToggleGroup endpoint switch
The 10% path stops dictating the geometry of the 90% path: popover content 622 px → 317 px, identical in both states
Widths are 1:1 measured pixels (GtkWidget::measure, libadwaita 1.9.2, Cantarell 11) · heights drawn at 0.75 to fit the sheet
Today — two GtkCalendar side by side
622 px content width — in BOTH popover states
anchored on the header-bar date pill
the only thing that names the endpoints
Esc closes the popover · Ctrl+Shift+D reopens it on the active row
① The width is already paid in both states today: GtkRevealer reports its child’s minimum width while collapsed, so the preset-only popover is 622 px wide from the first frame.
② One GtkCalendar (293 × 229) edits whichever endpoint the AdwToggleGroup has active. AdwToggleGroup is libadwaita 1.7+, so it is available on the pinned 1.9 — nothing is invented.
③ Monotonic clamp: a start after the end pushes the end, and vice versa, so `from > to` is unreachable. Picking a day while the other endpoint is empty mirrors into it — one pick, valid range.
④ Screen readers: the calendar’s accessible label follows the active endpoint (“Start date” / “End date”); the range summary is a polite live region, so every pick is announced as a range.
⑤ Nothing labels the two grids today (`src/ui/date_pill.rs:105-110`); the summary underneath is the only clue. The toggle group makes both roles explicit on screen and to assistive tech.
⑥ Cost: +46 px height (613 → 659) for the toggle group, and one signal-block guard when the calendar date is set programmatically as the active endpoint changes.
